title: ProductMaintainability
description: TOGAF-sourced quality archetype — Maintainability viability dimension. Defines the property vocabulary for maintainability governance: deployment strategy, rollback capability, architectural modularity. Rootless archetype — used as qualifier in Directives/Norms and as data type for Effectors/Receptors carrying maintainability state. Source framework: TOGAF (Architecture Governance, Change Management) + ISO/IEC 25010 (Maintainability sub-characteristic — Modularity, Reusability, Modifiability).

deploymentStrategy.description: Deployment strategy for releasing changes. ROLLING = incremental instance replacement. BLUE_GREEN = parallel environment swap. CANARY = progressive traffic shift. RECREATE = full teardown and rebuild.

rollbackCapable.description: Whether automated rollback to the previous version is supported.

modularity.description: Architectural modularity classification. MONOLITHIC = single deployable unit. MODULAR = internal module boundaries. MICROSERVICE = independently deployable services.
